name: conspiratorial
quote: We're planning to get people to boycott that business.
description: Being part of a group that is considering or implementing a surprise action affecting someone or something.

variations.name: positive conspiracy
variations.description: A group implementing a surprise that will benefit the target.
examples: planning a big surprise party for someone

variations.name: negative conspiracy
variations.description: A group implementing a surprise that will negatively impact the target.

comparisons.description: Conspiratorial is the experience of carrying out an actual conspiracy, while 'conspiracy minded' is the perception that conspiracies are afoot everywhere.

commentaries.quote: Being involved in any kind of hidden aggression is likely to bond you close to some people and irritate or anger others. It might be worth considering whether the cost of social trust is worth the desired new status quo.

conditions: Being part of a group that is considering or implementing a surprise action affecting someone or something.

description: Positive and negative conspiracy are perceived differently. One is an act of friendship, one is an attack.
